review-code.description: Run a comprehensive code review using the review-toolkit agents
review-code.template: Run a comprehensive code review of the current changes or files the user specifies. First call git status / git diff to determine scope (or use the files the user provided), size the change using CLAUDE.md and run its fixed gate: small — code-reviewer; standard — code-reviewer, silent-failure-hunter, pr-test-analyzer; feature — those three plus architect and security-lead. qa-lead CHECK remains a separate test-integrity audit, not a gate reviewer. type-design-analyzer, comment-analyzer and code-simplifier are optional, not part of the gate, and run only on explicit request. Name the model explicitly in every reviewer dispatch. Launch the required reviewers concurrently via the Task tool, keep reviews read-only, and wait for every reviewer to return. Aggregate findings into Critical Issues, Important Issues, Suggestions, Strengths, and a Recommended Action plan. Only report issues with confidence >= 80.
